best_parts: node r1_x1: tempting-then-refute feedback (colic read as simple), claims K50/K62/K15, plus sure_note hypercorrection. Model feedback for a confident error.
node r4b_x1: the timeline repair (each number belongs to one decision: contrast 24 h, second look 24-48 h, trial limit 72 h), with the 'numbers in ascending order' temptation named.
node r2_x1 / r3_x1: each names the tempting model, refutes it with the claim, then states the right order. Consistent template across the segment.
flaws: node r6 (choices 'Fever and a fast pulse' and 'Localised guarding'): tagged TR22 but they are true strangulation signs; a learner who picks them does not hold the TR22 model, so the trap tag misdescribes the wrong belief (R2, R9).
no fast lane and no agency ('Why?') anywhere in the segment; every learner gets the same path (R5).
lactate (K67) is never probed though O4 names it; paralytic ileus (O12) is never probed, only Ogilvie's (R3).

best_parts: node f6a / f6b: each wrong timing gets its own feedback (48 h is the second-look window; 72 h is the trial limit, not the contrast check) with a claim, so the wrong model is named per option.
node ex_why: asks the learner to give the reason for the trial failure after the choice; the hint hwh points to the risk to the bowel wall (K15). Good generation step.
node r31 / p5 choices: 'NG tube and a 72-hour review, with no fluids yet' and 'Emergency laparotomy, with fluids to follow in theatre' are plausible TR23/TR31 models.
flaws: node ex_q: A (fluids, potassium, NG, catheter) and B (look for strangulation) are correct steps but are offered as the 'wrong step' distractors (traps TR31 and TR22). A learner who picks them is not holding a trap, and the choice cannot diagnose anything.
nodes fA and fB open 'Why it is wrong:' and then say 'Right: step A is correct' / 'Right: step B is correct'. The feedback contradicts itself on each correct-step option.

node ex_why_ok is the longest option of its probe and the only one stating a sufficient reason; the key is findable by length (DP1). Also p7 sends three distinct wrong timing orders to one shared feedback f7, so the wrong model is not named (R2, R9).

best_parts: node c1_t31 and c3_t22: 'Show me the worked case' and 'Why does constant pain matter?' are agency routes after a miss, giving a different second explanation (worked case, mechanism) rather than the same one repeated.
node c1_ok 'Skip the worked case' (fast lane to c3) and the probe-first design of c3, c4, c5, c7, c10: the adaptivity and ask-before-tell pattern is the strongest of the three.
node c10 and c8: paralytic ileus (hypokalaemia) and Ogilvie's are each probed with a plausible wrong model (relaparotomy for a leak; colonoscopy first), covering the full O12 scope.
flaws: node c6: the key 'Emergency laparotomy before resuscitation' is the longest option and the only one with 'before' (DP1). The trap options are the NG tube and catheter, which are actually steps of resuscitation, so the 'NOT' item is partly a trick about which step is optional.

partial-tagged distractors with no trap mapping: c2_p (24-48 h is the TR26 timing trap, mislabelled), c5_p (failed trial is a true indication, so it is dominated for a learner with surface knowledge), c6_p, c7_p, c8_p, c9_p, c10_p. About a quarter of the wrong options carry no trap, which weakens R2 and R9.
node c1_ok: a correct pick is routed straight into a worked explanation (w2) that tells the screen before the next probe; learners who got the first decision right are told rather than asked (R1).

merge_ideas: a's clean probe-and-feedback spine (tempting, refute, claim, right) plus c's agency routes ('Show me the worked case', 'Why does constant pain matter?') after a miss, so every trap has both a hint ladder and a different second explanation.
c's fast lane (skip the worked case on a correct first pick) added to a's rung structure, so experts reach the same probes with fewer nodes.
b's per-number timing feedback (f6a / f6b) grafted onto a's r4a and r4b rungs, replacing a's shared feedback for the timing traps.
a's r6 with the fever and guarding distractors re-mapped to a non-TR22 model (for example 'signs are the normal post-op reaction'), and a lactate probe added so O4 is covered in full.
c's partial distractors (c2_p, c5_p) rewritten as TR26 and TR23 traps so that every wrong option names a wrong model.
